descriptionFull: The dark-eyed junco ( Junco hyemalis ) is a species of the juncos, a genus of small grayish American sparrows. This bird is common across much of temperate North America and in summer ranges far into the Arctic. It is a very variable species, much like the related fox sparrow ( Passerella iliaca ), and its systematics are still not completely untangled.
